## About this demo

This small report section demonstrates the sidebar navigation, page layout,
and shared NBIS branding of the `folium` multi-page template.

## What the skill configures

- project metadata, with the project title in `subtitle` so `title` keeps
  deriving from the NBIS ID;
- the GitHub Pages workflow, aligned with `project.output-dir` so a local render
  and CI write to the same place;
- required Quarto extensions, at pinned versions;
- reproducible dependency handling when code is enabled — `renv.lock` for R,
  `requirements.txt` or `pyproject.toml` for Python, or `pixi.lock` for a
  pixi-managed environment.

This fixture is tracked in the repository so the demo renders reproducibly,
independent of upstream template changes. Its Quarto extensions are not vendored:
they are installed at pinned versions at build time, which also means the demo
build exercises the same install path the skill puts in front of users.
